query:
select id, left(title,50) as title, type, status, taxonomy, source_label, left(source_detail::text,200) as sd
from carousel_drafts
where client_id like 'risedtc%' and (
  id in ('a49841c6-2d49-46bf-bc04-5afcb346dd94','a1c1580f-0000-0000-0000-000000000000','ad3b9a7c-7102-4d54-99b3-b64d16ab4a2e')
  or title ilike '%DTC Growth Team%' or title ilike '%Return Rate Rescue%' or title ilike '%AI Kit launch%')
